errors.says: For both label fields (Q^h with form x^T(I-J/9)y, and F_2^h with the dot product) the triple indicators satisfy <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1.
errors.paper: The formula <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, <t_T,t_T>=2 holds for the rational form of the bit network. For the complex network the paper uses F_2^h with the ordinary dot product, where t_S.t_T=|S∩T| mod 2 and t_T.t_T=1. Over F_2, |S∩T|-1 would give the wrong self-pairing (2≡0). The conclusion (nondegenerate triple lines, orthogonal neighbours) is right in both fields.

errors.says: Method: lay out the selected bits so that every round is one simultaneous butterfly layer, with fewer than log t passes.
errors.paper: Only the qK rounds on the remaining chunks use the simultaneous layer. The leading round on long axes and the bottom rounds h=b-1,...,0 on prefix slots (at most b+1<=K rounds) are processed bit by bit at cost O(TpdK).

errors.says: Method: run l rounds, each a simultaneous layer, plus <=K individual rounds on the prefix.
errors.paper: There are at most l rounds in all: the prefix rounds (at most b+1<=K) are part of the l, and only qK of them are simultaneous layers. The plan's count is an over-count; the cost bound O(Tp l d^{lambda'}) still holds.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}): the fixed network, frames and labels give s<Wm and tau=1-2^{-50}; then the two recursive primitives (chunk interchange, simultaneous layer); synthetic transforms and ring convolution; resampling and chirps with the permutations retained; CRT, twist, the six-step algorithm, the exact-recovery error chain and the margin table. Each link is derived from the paper's own lines. It thins only at supporting points: the stream and controlled-shift lemmas are used but never stated, the computed twist procedure appears only through its error count, the conjugation definition of F~^+ is missing, and the conjecture's negation is only named.

steps.note: h=100, v=binom(h,3), N=v^3, m=h^3, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by T^3, and a fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire, with the wire counts W_b, W_c.

A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}. Only endpoint frames matter, leaving intermediate frames free to make edges cheap (motivation of S1.2).
Nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, nested on every edge. The only decreasing edges are the central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing P⊗F of dimension h.
P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U, so an edge costs its label's dimension change. The N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} are the exceptions, each of rank one where the dimension change is zero.
Source total N and sink total Wm-N telescope to Wm-2N; the Ic decreasing edges of loss h give L=Ich and Sum|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L; with the N extra source ranks, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2. The deficit N-2L_b>0 gives s_b<W_b m, and the complex deficit is 2N-2L_c>0.

M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a} for X_a; zero source and identity sink otherwise). With frames Phi_M, the output is Phi_{I_m}f_w, i.e. H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.

Rank-a shear factored as E_1 Pi E_2 with triangular parts in O(V) and exactly a interchanges for the ones of Pi. Each edge's Phi_{A_e} makes rank(A_e) recursive interchanges, so a node makes exactly s calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_0=O(1), F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 give s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and the two-case geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain with its defining content and in the paper's order: the h=100 bank-exchange network, frames commuting with pointwise gates, nested labels with the central 3->4 losses, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source edges, the budget Wm-2N+2L giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict saving from L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges via E_1 Pi E_2, and the recurrence solved with tau=1-2^{-50}. All nine steps are reconstructed.
